lede: The biggest thing happening this week is Town Council's third reading of the Colorado Wildfire Resiliency Code on Tuesday — if it passes, it rewrites historic and architectural review standards and landscaping rules valley-wide, so this one's worth paying attention to. Ridgway's council is also holding a public hearing on the Hyde Subdivision resubdivision and a joint work session on its draft Housing Action Plan Wednesday night. On the county side, the Planning Commission takes up an energy code update and a subdivision work session Thursday, and SMART's board meets virtually to vote on restructuring the Gondola Advisory Committee tied to the voter-approved 3A gondola tax.

notable.stake: Third reading could permanently alter LUC historic review and landscaping rules.
Public hearing on Hyde Subdivision resubdivision; Housing Action Plan joint work session.
Energy code update and subdivision mechanics review could reshape county building standards.
